# The RT64 shaders the web page builds before the game starts: one shader description a line, other mode L and H,
# color combiner L and H, flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and compiles them
# all while the page shows "Preparing graphics", so no scene waits on a shader and none draws with the ubershader,
# which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded from the page opened with ?record-shaders, which prints every description RT64 meets, at the page's
# default settings, in headless Chrome: the DK Rap, the title screen and its attract loop (DK TV demos of later
# levels, Creepy Castle among them, and the Dolby screen), the main menu, Options, file select, a new game's opening
# cutscenes, DK's house, the pause menu, Training Grounds (on land, swimming, the tunnel out) and the cutscene after
# Quit Game. Most of them came from the DK Rap; the DK TV demos and the last minutes of play added none. Not yet:
# DK Isles, Jungle Japes or any level played by hand, the other Kongs, bosses, bonus barrels and minigames, Kong
# Battle (multiplayer, off by default and needing a second controller). A description missing here draws with the
# ubershader until its shader is built. Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a
# change to one of those defaults means recording again.
